summary: First round of testing for PGMEI clone. Backend /api/identificacao fully tested with pytest (8/8 passing): valid/invalid CNPJs, formatted/digits-only input, repeated digits rejection, wrong DV rejection, missing payload validation (422), Mongo persistence (no 500). Frontend tested end-to-end via Playwright: page loads, header/title/footer/version/selo visible, CNPJ mask applied correctly (00.000.000/0000-00), real-time validation shows error on invalid CNPJ and disables Continuar button, button only enables when CNPJ valid AND captcha checked, submission produces success alert with mock message and formatted CNPJ. All data-testids present.

issues: The success alert (data-testid=pgmei-resposta) renders in a narrow right-side column next to the form fields instead of below the form, causing awkward text wrapping. Consider making pgmei-alert span the full panel-body width (block below form) rather than appearing inline next to the input column.

action_items: (Minor/optional) Improve layout of pgmei-resposta alert so it renders as a full-width block below the form instead of in a narrow column beside the input.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: @app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in newer FastAPI; prefer lifespan context manager. Not blocking.

server.py: CORS allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins='*' is contradictory per CORS spec; browsers will reject credentialed requests. Consider setting explicit origins when credentials are needed. Not an issue for this public mock endpoint.
PGMEIHome.tsx: errors from axios are swallowed into a generic message; fine for a study clone but logging the error would help debugging.
Overall code is clean, well-structured, fully in Portuguese and matches the problem statement.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth. Valid CNPJ: 11.222.333/0001-81. Invalid CNPJ: 11.111.111/1111-11
seed_data_creation: None. Each identificacao call writes to db.identificacoes collection as designed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_identificacao.py is the canonical regression file. All functional acceptance criteria from the review_request have been verified green. Only a minor layout concern remains (success alert sits in narrow right column).
